edges.reason: msg.sender receives the entire initial supply inside the constructor.
msg.sender is used as the key when reading and writing the balances mapping.
msg.sender indexes the allowed mapping as owner in approve and as spender in transferFrom.
transferFrom reads and decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
Constructor assigns the token name.
Constructor assigns the token symbol.
Constructor assigns the token decimals.
Constructor mints the fixed _totalSupply.
Constructor credits balances[msg.sender] with the whole supply.
Constructor emits Transfer to the untrusted msg.sender address.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] as the burned balance.
_totalSupply is the minuend of the unchecked subtraction.
balances[address(0)] is the subtrahend of the unchecked subtraction.
Result of the unchecked subtraction is returned by totalSupply, allowing underflow of the reported supply.
approve writes the new allowance into allowed[msg.sender][spender].
approve performs the allowance overwrite without a zero-value precondition, enabling the classic allowance race.
The unsafe approval pattern results in an unconditional write to the allowed mapping.
transfer calls safeSub to decrement the sender balance.
transfer calls safeAdd to increment the recipient balance.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping for both accounts.
transfer uses the untrusted msg.sender as the sending account.
transferFrom calls safeSub on the balance and on the allowance.
transferFrom calls safeAdd on the recipient balance.
transferFrom updates balances[from] and balances[to].
transferFrom decrements the allowed allowance of the caller.
safeSub return value is assigned back into the balances mapping.
safeAdd return value is assigned back into the balances mapping.
transfer parameter 'to' indexes the balances mapping for the credit.
transfer parameter 'tokens' is the subtrahend of safeSub.
transfer parameter 'tokens' is the addend of safeAdd.
transferFrom parameter 'from' indexes the balances mapping.
transferFrom parameter 'to' indexes the balances mapping.
transferFrom parameter 'tokens' is subtracted from balance and allowance.
transferFrom parameter 'tokens' is added to the recipient balance.
approve parameter 'spender' indexes the allowed mapping.
approve parameter 'tokens' becomes the stored allowance value.
balanceOf parameter 'tokenOwner' indexes the balances mapping.
allowance parameter 'tokenOwner' indexes the outer allowed mapping.
allowance parameter 'spender' indexes the inner allowed mapping.
safeAdd operand a flows into the addition.
safeAdd operand b flows into the addition.
safeSub operand a flows into the subtraction.
safeSub operand b flows into the subtraction and the require check.
safeMul operand a flows into the multiplication.
safeMul operand b flows into the multiplication.
safeDiv numerator flows into the division.
safeDiv denominator flows into the division and the require check.
Named return variable 'balance' carries balances[tokenOwner] out of balanceOf.
Named return variable 'remaining' carries the allowance out of allowance.
Named return variable 'success' is returned by approve.
Named return variable 'success' is returned by transfer.
Named return variable 'success' is returned by transferFrom.
Return variable c of safeAdd holds the checked sum.
Return variable c of safeSub holds the checked difference.
Return variable c of safeMul holds the checked product.
Return variable c of safeDiv holds the quotient.
